name: SeedLegals
description: Connect Claude to your SeedLegals account to work with your company's equity and legal documents. Ask about your cap table ownership, dilution, share classes, and SEIS/EIS scheme breakdowns, and see outstanding actions across your workflows. Find, read, and ask questions about your agreements, check who still needs to sign, send signature reminders, and share documents with your team. You can also create and update documents such as board minutes and employment agreements, directly from the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SeedLegals to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SeedLegals to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.seedlegals.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SeedLegals MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SeedLegals provides these MCP tools: create_document, get_cap_table, get_document_metadata, get_outstanding_actions, list_documents, list_user_companies, query_document, recommend_document, send_signature_reminder, share_document, submit_feedback, and update_document.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SeedLegals?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SeedLegals in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
SeedLegals requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SeedLegals is developed by Seedlegals. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
